purpose: Imagine a better result under a condition that is not met.
keywords: give explain a reason cause result
If I had a car, I could go to the sea.
If it were a little cheaper, I would buy it.
If I had known the address, I could have sent a letter.
restrictions: Often expresses regret, disappointment, or a wish.
mistake: のに here expresses an unrealized result, not an actual contradiction.

segments.role: Imagine a better result under a condition that is not met. Conditional ば-clause + result + のに
